name: Hyperia
description: The UK's tallest, fastest and most weightless roller coaster — and one of the most extraordinary new coasters to open anywhere in Europe in the last decade. Hyperia stands a breathtaking 236 feet (72 metres) above Thorpe Park and reaches speeds exceeding 80 mph (129 km/h), taking the crown as the UK's fastest coaster from the legendary Stealth. Built by Mack Rides and opened in May 2024 to celebrate Thorpe Park's 45th anniversary, Hyperia features Europe's tallest inversion at 168 feet and the world's first outer-banked airtime hill — a completely unique element found nowhere else on the planet. The ride's mythological theme centres on Hyperia, the fearless daughter of an ancient river god, and the lap bar-only restraint system creates extraordinary feelings of weightlessness throughout the 995-metre layout. Min. height: 130cm.

name: Stealth
description: For years the undisputed king of Thorpe Park — Stealth is a Hydraulic Launch Coaster by Intamin that accelerates from 0 to 80 mph in just 1.9 seconds, sending riders over a towering 205-foot top hat element in a ride that lasts just 17 exhilarating seconds from launch to brake run. The launch is a genuinely shocking, violent experience that compresses riders into their seats with enormous force before the coaster crests the iconic red top hat and plummets back down. Even with Hyperia's arrival, Stealth remains one of the most visceral and talked-about experiences in the UK. Min. height: 140cm.

name: Colossus
description: When Colossus opened at Thorpe Park in 2002 it held the world record for the most inversions on any roller coaster — a staggering ten loops, corkscrews and heartlines that flip riders upside down more times than any other coaster on earth. Built by Intamin, the record has since been beaten but Colossus remains one of the most intense and visually spectacular coasters in the UK. The sheer number of inversions creates a prolonged, disorientating and exhilarating experience unlike anything else at Thorpe Park. The Lost City theming adds atmosphere to the queue experience. Min. height: 140cm.

name: The Swarm
description: A spectacular B&M Wing Coaster — the UK's only Wing Coaster — where riders sit in pairs extending beyond both sides of the track with nothing above or below their feet as the coaster sweeps through five inversions at terrifying speed. The post-apocalyptic theme is brilliantly executed with crashed aircraft, an overturned fire engine and haunting atmospheric details throughout the queue and ride experience. The Swarm's unique Wing Coaster format creates the sensation of true flight that conventional coasters cannot replicate. Min. height: 140cm.

name: SAW - The Ride
description: Europe's first horror movie-themed roller coaster — a terrifying Gerstlauer Euro-Fighter themed to the Saw franchise that takes riders through a beyond-vertical drop of over 100 degrees inside a dark enclosed building before launching back outside for more inversions. The indoor section recreates the atmosphere of the Saw films with disturbing sounds, lighting effects and imagery before the signature beyond-vertical plunge delivers one of the most shocking moments of any ride in the UK. Min. height: 140cm.

name: Nemesis Inferno
description: A ferocious B&M Inverted Coaster where riders sit in hanging trains with legs dangling freely as the coaster tears through seven inversions at relentless speed. Nemesis Inferno is widely considered one of the smoothest and most consistently thrilling coasters at Thorpe Park — less extreme than Hyperia or Stealth but delivering a sustained, high-quality inversion sequence that leaves riders breathless. The volcanic jungle theming and roaring soundtrack create an immersive experience from queue to ride. Min. height: 140cm.

name: Tidal Wave
description: Europe's tallest water ride when it opened — Tidal Wave sends riders up an 85-foot tower before plunging straight down into a spectacular wall of water that soaks everyone in the boat and everyone watching from the viewing bridge. The soaking is legendary and completely guaranteed regardless of where you sit. On a warm day Tidal Wave is one of the most refreshing and exhilarating experiences at Thorpe Park — and the viewing platform is free to use for spectators who enjoy watching others get drenched. Min. height: 110cm.

name: Detonator
description: A classic drop tower that lifts riders to the top of a 30-metre tower before dropping them in a sudden, brutal freefall — one of the most consistently screamed-at attractions at Thorpe Park. Detonator is compact but delivers an excellent, accessible freefall experience with a clear view over the park and surrounding Surrey landscape from the top. Min. height: 130cm.

name: Rush
description: A dramatic pendulum swing ride that sweeps riders through a massive 360-degree arc at terrifying speed — one of the largest swinging attractions of its type in the UK. Rush delivers intense positive and negative g-forces at the peak of each swing and is a genuine thrill for riders who want something more intense than a traditional swing ship. Min. height: 130cm.

name: Storm Surge
description: A spinning water ride that delivers exciting twists and a guaranteed soaking as spinning boats are swept around a circular channel and over a dramatic finale drop. Storm Surge is one of Thorpe Park's most popular family water attractions on warm days — the spinning boats create unpredictable experiences where some riders get completely soaked while others escape relatively dry. Min. height: 110cm.

name: Vortex
description: A suspended chair swing attraction that spins riders outward at speed while simultaneously tilting the entire rotating platform — delivering a disorienting and dizzying experience that combines the sensation of spinning with a rocking, tilting platform. Vortex is one of the most popular flat rides at Thorpe Park and consistently draws crowds despite its relatively gentle nature. Min. height: 140cm.

name: The Walking Dead: The Ride
description: Formerly X: No Way Out — the world's first backwards-in-the-dark roller coaster — now reimagined as an immersive horror experience themed to the Walking Dead. Riders travel backwards through a post-apocalyptic dark environment filled with zombies, disturbing scenes and jump scares before the coaster launches them forward through the layout. A uniquely atmospheric and genuinely unsettling experience. Min. height: 140cm.

name: Ghost Train
description: Thorpe Park's acclaimed immersive dark ride experience — a unique blend of physical sets, live actors and virtual reality that creates a genuinely terrifying journey through a haunted underground train network. Ghost Train is unlike any conventional theme park dark ride and is frequently cited as one of the most innovative and frightening experiences at any UK theme park. Not for the faint-hearted. Min. height: 130cm.

name: Flying Fish
description: Originally Thorpe Park's very first roller coaster from 1984 — now reimagined as a delightful family coaster perfect for young riders experiencing their first coaster thrills. Flying Fish winds through a gentle layout at accessible speeds making it the ideal introduction to roller coasters for families with younger children. Min. height: 90cm.
